decode_working_set.corrects: z1t_preflight.py's 38.9x, which is the cost of UNROLLING T=1024 onto the fabric rather than streaming decode. The arithmetic was right; the framing implied a cost nobody would actually pay.

energy_claim_check.claim: 1.5 W static x 58.8 us ~ 88 nJ, ~30% of the FPGA bill
energy_claim_check.verdict: WRONG by ~1000x: 1.5 W for 58.8 us is 88.2 uJ, not 88 nJ
energy_claim_check.and_it_cannot_be_a_unit_slip_alone: at 1.5 W a 58.8 us token would cost 88,200 nJ, which is 299x Extropic's entire published per-token budget of 294.52 nJ

implied_by_published_figures.note: so the FPGA averages about 4.9 mW on these numbers, not 1.5 W

energy_claim_check.what_survives: the CONCLUSION -- that the FPGA cost is orchestration and round-trips rather than arithmetic -- may well be true. It is simply not supported by this calculation.
